messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, mobile-friendly 2D roleplaying game where players choose a hero or roll dice, then make story choices that determine the ending.

## Requirements
- Support phones and tablets with responsive layouts and touch-friendly controls.
- Provide at least two story directions and endings that depend on player choices.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained, no-dependency browser game, “The Last Lantern,” in a single HTML file.
- Used four hero roles with distinct traits, three story chapters, branching choices, tracked stats/items, and multiple endings.
- Created original inline SVG scene illustrations rather than relying on external game assets.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game interface, responsive styling, hero selection and random dice roll, narrative choices, stats/inventory, help modal, reset/replay, and story-dependent endings.
- Validated JavaScript syntax with `node --check`.
- Tested multiple story paths and endings using Playwright; latest console check reported no errors.
- Captured and inspected screenshots at desktop and mobile sizes.

### Active
- No active work.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. If desired, do a final status check and summarize the completed game and its assumptions to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/landing.jpg`: Desktop setup screen capture.
- `screenshots/mobile.jpg`: Mobile setup screen capture.
- `screenshots/adventure.jpg`: Desktop gameplay screen capture.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Tested choice paths include ending titles “The Keeper’s Promise” and “A Lantern in the Dark.”
- A Python HTTP server was started on port 3002 for browser testing.

content.text:
Built **The Last Lantern**, a mobile-friendly 2D fantasy adventure.

Choose one of four heroes or roll for one, then make choices across three chapters to shape the ending. Open `index.html` in a browser to play.

Assumption: I made it a short, single-player story with original artwork. Tested multiple paths and endings in a browser.
